newsitem.title: UK: Pilot error blamed for crash of UK jet in Canada.
newsitem.headline: Pilot error blamed for crash of UK jet in Canada.

text.p: Pilot error was to blame for the crash of a British radar aircraft which plunged into Canada's Lake Ontario during an air show last year, killing all seven crew members on board, military investigators said on Friday.

The defence ministry said the four-engined Nimrod reconnaissance aircraft stalled at low altitude over the lake on September 2 because the pilot had disregarded regulations by cutting the plane's speed to a dangerously low level during a tricky manouevre.
The crash caused intense speculation in Canada as to its cause, with some experts suggesting that it had been caused by either engine failure or a bird strike.
A ministry statement said the official inquiry also blamed lax supervision which had allowed the pilot to develop unsafe flying techniques without his superiors noticing.
In future all Nimrod displays would be carried out by a specially-trained crew of instructors, the statement said.
